title: Accounts
description: The platforms' sign-in state; credentials live only in this device's secure storage.
empty: No platform supports signing in yet
qrDialogTitle: Sign in to {site} with a QR code
qrHint: Open the {site} mobile app, scan the code and confirm the sign-in.
cookieDialogHint: Copy the site's cookie from a signed-in browser and paste it below (name=value; name2=value2).
signOutConfirmDesc: The stored {site} credential leaves this device.
statusUnreadable: Cannot be read; paste the cookie again
statusRejected: The login expired; sign in again or replace the cookie
statusCheckFailed: Saved; the account could not be checked right now
statusStoredUnused: Saved, not used by requests yet
statusDouyuNoSession: Not set: the cookie carries no session token
statusDouyuExpired: The login expired; paste the cookie again
statusDouyuAutoRenew: The login holds; it renews itself before it ends
statusDouyuRenewsOnPlay: The login lapsed; it renews when you play
statusDouyuRepaste: The login is gone; tap to paste the cookie again
douyuCookieCleared: Cleared: no douyu login is stored
douyuCookieGuest: Guest: the cookie carries no session token; paste it again
douyuPairOnly: Renewal credentials saved, but there is no login cookie yet
douyuCookieValidAutoRenew: The login holds; LTP0 renews it before it ends (ends {time})
douyuCookieValidRepaste: The login holds (ends {time}), but no renewal credentials are saved
douyuCookieRenewable: The login lapsed; it renews on play (credentials end {time})
douyuCookieExpired: The login is gone ({time}); paste the cookie again
douyuLtp0Hint: Paste the LTP0 from a passport.douyu.com request
douyuDidHint: The dy_did of the device the login belongs to
douyuRenewNowDesc: Trade the current credentials for a fresh session at once to prove the renewal works, without waiting until it is due.
douyuCredentialsAbsorbed: Renewal credentials taken out; the stored login is kept
douyuCredentialsOnly: Renewal credentials saved (the douyu login cookie still needs pasting)
douyuRenewNoCookie: Fill in a cookie that carries the login before renewing
douyuRenewNoCredentials: No LTP0 or dy_did; the login cannot be renewed
douyuRenewNoSession: That cookie carries no session token; the login cannot be renewed
douyuRenewNoChange: The renewal returned no new session; the login is unchanged
douyuRenewFailed: The renewal failed; try again later
statusTwitchNoChat: Saved, but the cookie has no chat identity
statusHuyaNoUid: Saved, but the cookie has no account id
bilibiliLoginExpired: The bilibili login expired; you were signed out
savedAccountsNote: Accounts you signed in with are kept here (up to {count}); switching needs no new scan. Sign-ins are stored encrypted on this device only, and are erased when you sign out or remove them.
addAccountHint: Sign another account in with the QR code; the current one stays here
addAccountFull: {count} remembered; adding another forgets the one unused the longest
addFullConfirmDesc: {count} accounts are remembered; signing in another one forgets the one used longest ago. Continue?
switchConfirmDesc: Switch to “{name}”? Rooms you are watching reconnect their danmaku with this account.
forgetConfirmDesc: Remove the sign-in of “{name}” from this device? Using that account again needs a new sign-in.
accountsSaveFailed: The sign-in could not be saved: this device's secure storage failed. Try again.
webLoginSignInOnPage: Sign in on the page (SMS or password)
webLoginReading: Back on the main site; reading the sign-in…
webLoginFailed: The web sign-in did not finish
webLoginUnavailable: This device has no built-in browser
webLoginUnavailableDesc: The web sign-in needs one. Use the QR code, or sign in in a browser and paste its cookie in.
noLoginMethod: {site} has no sign-in method wired up yet
browserNotOpened: The system browser did not open
cookieInvalid: That does not read as a cookie; it needs name=value fields
cookieRejected: That cookie signs in nobody or has expired; nothing was saved
cookieSavedLocal: The cookie is saved on this device
discardDesc: These changes are not saved yet and are lost once you leave.
cookiePrivacy: The cookie is encrypted and kept on this device only; it is never uploaded. Sign out before leaving a shared device.
